title: CURE: Controlled Unlearning for Robust Embeddings — Mitigating Conceptual Shortcuts in Pre-Trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification accuracy and F1 score on out-of-distribution (OOD) test sets where spurious correlations between specific semantic concepts (e.g., 'Story', 'Service', 'Experience') and target labels (e.g., sentiment) are balanced, comparing the performance against an i.i.d. set with imbalanced, shortcut-inducing concept distributions.
